Chapter 97 My Mom Wants to Treat You to a Meal

"The contract is in duplicate. You keep this copy."

In the piano room, Yan Zhusheng accepted one copy of the contract. "The payment should arrive in about one or two weeks. Just keep an eye on your bank card notifications."

"Okay." Li Luo nodded with satisfaction.

He never expected this company to offer 80,000 yuan for a single theme song.

Moreover, this wasn't even a buyout of the song's full copyright, but simply some of the rights related to the TV drama's theme song.

In other words, if someone later wanted to perform his song in a commercial venue, such as a variety show, the copyright income from that would still belong to Li Luo.

"My mom said she'd like to treat you to a meal when she has some free time," Yan Zhusheng said after the contract was settled. "But she's been quite busy lately, so she's not sure when that will be."

"Sure." Li Luo nodded without thinking much of it. "Just have Auntie call me whenever she's free."

"She's been preparing for her new album recently," Yan Zhusheng added as an explanation. "And after signing for your song, the company arranged for her to sing this theme song, so she'll be very busy for a while."

"Huh?" Li Luo was stunned for a moment, not quite processing it. "Your mom is a singer?"

To be honest, in his past life, Li Luo had worked at Yan Zhusheng's house for about half a year.

Later, Yan Zhusheng went abroad for treatment due to her heart condition.

During that time, Li Luo had never met Yan Zhusheng's mother, so he naturally had no idea what she did.

"Yes," Yan Zhusheng nodded. "But she hasn't been in this line of work for a long time. She went abroad for treatment and recovery due to illness, and her health has only slowly improved in recent years."

"May I be so bold as to ask your mother's name?"

"Yuan Wanqing."

"Hmm..." Li Luo thought back for a moment. In his memory, there hadn't been much news about this person in the last couple of years.

From the looks of it, Yuan Wanqing's new album probably didn't do very well.

"Oh, right, there's something else I wanted to ask you," Li Luo said again. "About that song, 'Waiting For You After Class,' why don't you ask your mom if anyone at her company might be interested in it?"

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng nodded in understanding. "Okay, I'll help you ask tomorrow."

After saying this, Yan Zhusheng sat back down at the piano, then suddenly thought of something else. She looked up at Li Luo and reminded him in a quiet voice, "Um... before, Auntie Luo Fei thought I wrote the song myself, so she arranged it for me for free."

"After you receive the copyright payment, could you transfer her a fee for the arrangement?"

"Although she didn't ask for it herself, if you have new songs in the future, you can build a good relationship with her. Auntie Luo Fei is really good at song arrangement."

"How much should I generally give?" Li Luo asked.

"It doesn't have to be a lot," Yan Zhusheng herself wasn't sure. "A few thousand yuan as a gesture should be fine."

"Okay, I'll remember that." Li Luo nodded, and then he heard the sound of a door opening from outside the room.

"Li Luo! Where are you?"

Ying Chanxi's shout came in, "I'm back with the groceries, it's time to cook."

"Then I'll go cook now. You can play the piano for a while to relax."

"Okay."

Li Luo waved and walked out of the piano room.

The next second, a melodious tune flowed from behind him.

Ying Chanxi's gaze instantly locked onto Li Luo. She moved closer to inspect his collar and face. "What were you doing in there?"

"Chatting with our guest for a bit." Li Luo pressed a hand on Ying Chanxi's head and guided her toward the kitchen. "Come and be my assistant."

"I know, let go." Ying Chanxi puffed out her cheeks and batted his hand away. "Don't touch my hair, it'll stunt my growth."

"So superstitious?"

Li Luo took an apron from the kitchen wall and passed it to Ying Chanxi.

But Ying Chanxi didn't take it with her hands. She just lowered her head, slipped it on over her head, then turned around and said, "Help me tie it."

After helping each other tie their aprons, the two got busy in the kitchen.

Lunch was a lavish affair. It was Qiao Xinyan's first time eating Li Luo's cooking, and she exclaimed in amazement as she ate.

"Li Luo, were you a chef in your past life?" Qiao Xinyan swallowed the food in her mouth and couldn't help but say, "This feels even better than what they make in restaurants."

Li Luo: "...As long as you think it's good."

After lunch, Ying Chanxi felt a bit sleepy and pulled Qiao Xinyan back to the bedroom for a nap. The two girls went to cuddle on the bed.

Xu Youyu, on the other hand, sidled up next to Yan Zhusheng, threw her arms around her, and said with a grin, "Zhusheng, how about you wash the dishes with me? We can chat."

"Oh, okay." The simple and innocent Yan Zhusheng didn't overthink it. At Xu Youyu's invitation, she obediently went into the kitchen to await instructions, leaving Li Luo speechless.

But with this, once the living room was empty, Zhao Rongjun became much more comfortable. His whole body relaxed, and he leaned back directly against the sofa. He had been sitting ramrod straight before.

"How about we go to school to play basketball later?" Li Luo plopped down next to Zhao Rongjun, glanced at the two slender figures washing dishes in the kitchen, and then asked.

"Aren't we studying this afternoon?" Zhao Rongjun asked, puzzled.

"What? You've gotten addicted to studying?" Li Luo shot him a look. "Weren't you very resistant to it before?"

"Was I resistant to studying?" Zhao Rongjun's face darkened. "You were clearly the one who gave me false intel."

"You didn't ask how many people there would be yesterday."

"Then you concealed the intel. It's your fault either way."

"Alright, alright." Li Luo said with a laugh. "Then let's go play basketball this afternoon and leave the four of them here."

"Is that... a little inappropriate?" Zhao Rongjun asked in a low voice. "After all, I'm not the only guest."

"I think you need to slightly change this habit of always considering others first," Li Luo patted his shoulder. "Besides, Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu are practically hosts here too. Isn't it enough for each of them to accompany one person? I'll just accompany you."

Put that way, Zhao Rongjun felt much better. "Alright then, what time are we going?"

"Let's rest for half an hour to digest." Li Luo stretched on the sofa, then went to the piano room to get his guitar. He strummed the strings lightly, humming a little tune.

But soon, Ying Chanxi's bedroom door was opened, and her complaining voice came from within, "Li Luo! Xinyan and I are trying to take a nap, keep it down."

"Oh, oh, sorry, I forgot." Li Luo sheepishly put his guitar away.

Unable to play the guitar to edify his soul, Li Luo could only go back to the master bedroom with Zhao Rongjun and play some two-player browser games on the computer.

When it was about time, they got up and set off to play basketball.

"Where are you two going?"

Xu Youyu, who was chatting with Yan Zhusheng in the living room, saw the two of them putting on their shoes at the door and asked in confusion, "Being all sneaky, what kind of trouble are you getting into without us?"

"We're going to school to play basketball." Li Luo rolled his eyes at her. "Do you guys know how to play? If not, don't ask to come."

"Even if we can't play, can't we watch?" Xu Youyu puffed out her chest defiantly and said in a menacing tone, "You two wait, I'm going too. Zhusheng, are you going?"

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng nodded. She didn't mind what they did, so she got up and walked toward the door. "Should we call the two of them?"

As she spoke, Yan Zhusheng pointed toward Ying Chanxi's bedroom and asked.

"They're probably still sleeping, let's not call them." Xu Youyu shook her head, went back to her room to change, then came to the door to put on her shoes. She gave Li Luo a hard slap on the back. "Let's go, move out!"

(End of this chapter)
